dataset.name: Incident relationship claims in retained Wikidata items
dataset.description: Read-only, single-response query over the existing role reader plus parent/child properties. No identity resolution, graph publication or financial attribution.

endpoints.name: wikidata_entities
endpoints.response_root: Retained wbgetentities response; no HTTP request by this query.

acquisition.pagination: No pagination or network. Query either endpoint in one supplied response with the complete expected item set; not an exhaustive neighborhood.

partitions.name: body
partitions.source: Exact response digest and explicit expected QIDs
partitions.purpose: Keep separate observations separate, without FEC-cycle validity assumptions.

acquisition.retry_policy: No acquisition, retry, endpoint expansion or refresh selection. API errors and malformed envelopes fail; they do not become empty relationship results. Existing background acquisition policy is unchanged.

physical_schema.encoding: Strict UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys, invalid surrogates and trailing JSON rejected.
physical_schema.null_policy: Source-missing items, unloaded items, unknown/no-value snaks and unsupported statements remain distinct. A missing object never becomes a fabricated endpoint.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Shared closed entity/statement/snak/time reader used by role-statements@1.0.0. Four MiB, twenty explicit expected items, ten thousand total statements. Query matches only selected properties and known source endpoints. Unsupported outgoing statements survive with issues; an unparseable incoming target cannot be matched.

identity.publisher_record_key: Item QID, item revision, property and statement ID; duplicate IDs do not merge occurrences.
identity.occurrence_locator: Body digest plus /entities/QID/claims/property/zero-based-index and exact raw statement digest/bytes.
identity.record_version: Source bytes and item revision; labels and aliases belong only to the supplied response.
identity.duplicate_policy: Retain all incident occurrences. Opposite parent/child statements stay separate evidence, not independent verification or another synthesized edge.

children.locator: Original statement pointer and array position

time_fields.meaning: Reported relationship time at source precision, not observation time or current validity. Shared role_time.go profile; unsupported values remain explicit.

rules: Preserve the existing P108/P112/P169/P3320/P127/P1830/P39/P488 meanings and raw evidence. The old ExtractRoles function and discovery consumers retain their original property set and contract.

P355 reports a child organization or unit, subject parent and object child. P749 reports a parent organization or unit, subject child and object parent. Expose this display mapping alongside the unchanged source predicate/direction.

Hierarchy does not establish legal corporate type, ownership percentage, control, direct or ultimate parentage. Role category is not_applicable; do not populate personal-role holder fields for hierarchy.

Keep ranks, duplicate occurrences, self-relations, time precision, uninterpreted qualifiers and references. Do not choose current statements, compare intervals or infer personal relationships from common organizations.
Optional observation timestamp is validated RFC3339 caller metadata. Missing observation time remains missing; a body checksum does not authenticate acquisition time or publisher.
A query requires a wikidata:QID, not a name or FEC appearance. Empty matches describe this limited input and property set, not real-world absence. No identity merge or financial change.

revisions.publisher_model: Mutable community-curated item statements with qualifiers and ranks.
revisions.effective_projection: No latest selection, cross-response merging, accepted relationship truth or graph publication.

checks.rule: Verify exact body digest, complete expected IDs, closed envelope and byte/entity/statement limits before returning results.
Every selected occurrence with a matching parseable source endpoint survives, including duplicates and malformed outgoing claims.
Keep identity, graph and financial approval false; report coverage, missing endpoint and time limits.

scenarios: Distinct board terms and original date precision
Multiple parent assertions without validity dates
No FEC-employer match implied by a discovery result

use.retention: Reuse existing source bodies and acquisition records. This query has no publication or retention workflow.
use.disclaimer: Community statements are contextual evidence, not independently verified identities, affiliations, ownership or money flows.
